2981-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.

2981-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-6662-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.

1479-2841-6662-8104.description:

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5571-6331-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

777-1170-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.

Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

1373-1479-2515-3470-7846.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1373-1479-2515-3470-7846.description:
Play Survivors' Encampment.
When Survivors' Encampment enters, Kodama, Hazezon and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 2/2 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
When the Sand Warriors enter, Kodama triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Survivors' Encampment's second ability by tapping it and a Sand Warrior, adding {R}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning Survivors' Encampment from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything onto the battlefield.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger, putting Survivors' Encampment from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Survivors' Encampment enters,  Hazezon and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

849-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

You have a land card in hand.

2366-3512-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4452-5310-6797-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5310-6797-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

643-1399-1606-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

654-3293-5412-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
654-3293-5412-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
654-3293-5412-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1318-2198-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-2198-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Deceiver Exarch and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Deceiver Exarch and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Deceiver Exarch and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Deceiver Exarch tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-2198-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Deceiver Exarch. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Barkform Harvester twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-4416-6720-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-6720-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

944-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1542-5619-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1274-3490-5070-5231.description:
Gain life.

Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat step 2 as necessary.

Repeat.
